Author: Real Nunu
Name: Nunu's Windbound Bard
Punchline: MIDI workbench, Bard performance, ensemble arrangements and native concert capture.
Description: Windbound Bard MIDI suite with an in-game MIDI Workbench: piano roll and note editing, track tools, drum splitting with custom pitch maps, C3-C6 adaptation, undo/redo, SoundFont preview and MIDI/LRC export. Includes native ensembles, Soulweaver Studio, Showmaster and the separate Windows capture engine with MP4 recording and HD preview. Hide Game Performance HUD hides the native keyboard, guitar tone selector and metronome during playback.
Changelog: Added Hide Game Performance HUD to hide or restore the native keyboard, guitar tone selector and metronome during playback.
